heroHeadline: Pakistan Secures IMF Tranche as Afghanistan Border Tensions Persist
heroSubtitle: IMF approves $1.32B (3rd EFF review, May 8); Pakistan-Afghanistan ceasefire strained by three cross-border incidents; Field Marshal Munir chairs Corps Commanders Conference; Marka-e-Haq anniversary marked nationwide.
footerNote: Data sourced from official government records (Government of Pakistan, ECP, SBP, ISPR), major news outlets (Dawn, Reuters, AP, BBC, Al Jazeera), academic institutions, and international organizations (UN, IMF, World Bank, SIPRI, HRCP).
